tools.information-request-list-generator: Download a fillable .xlsx of the GST Information Request List, personalized to a target or client
Ten sections mirroring the canonical VDR taxonomy, with a Status cell (OPEN / PARTIAL / CLOSED) on every request row
Close the request → response loop: the recipient marks status, fills cells, and emails the file back instead of inventing a format
tools.information-request-list-extractor: Turn a filled IRL workbook back into canonical markdown, ready to paste into the sweep
Every answered row carried across verbatim, with its status and whatever sourcing the responder recorded
Runs entirely in your browser: the workbook is never uploaded and nothing is stored
